description: Turn an anxious spiral into a concrete list — separate the specific worries from the vague dread, sort what you can act on from what you can't, and get one action. Use when asked help me with my anxiety spiral, I can't stop worrying about, my mind won't stop racing, or break down what I'm anxious about. Not therapy.
